initialCondition: Stress-free 16 x 8 x 3.2 cm continuous lobe, zero damage and zero cracks. Temperature comes from a 1D cooling solve mapped by depth; prior 3D thermal stress history is not represented.

thermalProfile.method: 1D finite-volume enthalpy; radiation and convection at the top; metered 1450 K reservoir at depth.

reservoirInitialization: Enthalpy blends to 1450 K across x=-32 to -64 mm in the upstream pipe; fluid inlet does not grip a cold solid plug.
sourceQuadrature: Conservative partial-width source layers at a declared interval. This resolves mass influx before a full particle spacing has crossed the inlet; source volume is flux times elapsed interval, never a full cell per emission.
limits: Coarse mechanism screen. Nominal mixed constitutive references, no convergence or photorealism claim. No authored fracture geometry.
